offers_products.reason: Distributes MRO products: rotating equipment, bearings, power transmission, metalworking, safety and industrial supplies; also manufactures pumps.

offers_services.reason: Offers supply chain/tool crib management, equipment repair and rebuild, field service and maintenance, though products are the larger part.

sells_to_consumers.reason: Customers are industrial businesses: manufacturers, oil and gas, agriculture, construction and transportation; no household buyers.

sells_to_organizations.reason: Sells MRO supplies and pump solutions to industrial businesses across manufacturing, energy, and agriculture.

recurring_revenue.reason: Repeat MRO supply orders and supply chain inventory management contracts from industrial customers drive most revenue.

cyclical_demand.reason: Mostly maintenance, repair and operating supplies that keep plants running, though industrial and oil and gas activity adds some cyclicality.

big_ticket.reason: Typical sales are frequent, small MRO supplies, bearings, tools and parts, not large infrequent purchases.

people_delivered.reason: Mainly a distributor of goods; revenue comes from products sold, with services secondary.

large_customers.reason: Serves a broad base of industrial customers, from small shops to large plants; not mainly large enterprises or government.

asset_heavy.reason: Distribution model with inventory, service centers and branches; asset-light compared with heavy industry, growing largely by acquisition.

notes: Customer size mix is not stated on the website, so the large-customer answer is a judgment.
